name: durandal
description: Olifant in VS Code: conventions, generators, the TDD loop and plans over olifant lsp

untrustedWorkspaces.description: durandal.path chooses the binary the extension runs.

durandal.path.markdownDescription: The `olifant` binary: an absolute path, or a name looked up on `PATH`, `~/.local/bin`, `~/.cabal/bin` and `~/bin`.

durandal.debounceMs.markdownDescription: How long typing must pause before the server's slow work (suggestions) starts (`debounce_ms`).

durandal.model.markdownDescription: Which `[model.backends.NAME]` fills holes; empty: the project's `[model]` default.

durandal.fills.markdownDescription: A recorded `[fills]` file standing in for the model (tests, demos); empty: none.

durandal.trace.server.description: Trace the LSP traffic with olifant lsp into the Durandal output channel.

scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && tsc -p . && node out/test/e2e/run.js
